newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Morgan ups Bethlehem Steel.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Morgan ups Bethlehem Steel.

text.p: J.P. Morgan steel analyst Mike Gambardella said he raised his full-year '98 estimate on Bethlehem Steel Corp to a profit of $0.40 per share from a loss of $0.25 per share.
-- Gambardella cited the company's lower pension expense resulting from an acceleration of funding efforts.
-- Gambardella said Bethlehem Steel already reduced pension liability this year to $685 million from $870 million.
-- Gambardella said pension expense could decrease by $50 million in '98.
